## Acceptance Criteria to Test Case Mapping

| AC ID | Acceptance Criterion | Mapped Test Cases | Coverage Status |
|-------|---------------------|-------------------|-----------------|
| AC-1 | The user can access the "Confirm Process Order" Fiori app with an environmental monitoring input step. | TC-CS-167, TC-CS-168, TC-CS-177, TC-CS-178 | COVERED |
| AC-2 | The system requires entry of environmental readings at the process order operations flagged as environmentally controlled. | TC-CS-167, TC-CS-168, TC-CS-172, TC-CS-173, TC-CS-174, TC-CS-175, TC-CS-176, TC-CS-177, TC-CS-178 | COVERED |
| AC-3 | The system compares entered readings against predefined acceptable ranges and flags any out-of-range value. | TC-CS-167, TC-CS-169, TC-CS-170, TC-CS-171, TC-CS-179, TC-CS-180, TC-CS-181, TC-CS-182, TC-CS-183, TC-CS-184, TC-CS-185, TC-CS-186, TC-CS-187 | COVERED |
| AC-4 | An out-of-range environmental reading automatically triggers a linked deviation record. | TC-CS-169, TC-CS-170, TC-CS-171, TC-CS-181, TC-CS-184, TC-CS-187, TC-CS-188 | COVERED |
| AC-5 | Environmental monitoring data is included in the compiled Electronic Batch Record. | TC-CS-167, TC-CS-189 | COVERED |
